# Animal Health. Working Together.

Every farmer and vet knows that New Zealand farm production is a constant journey and at times an
unpredictable business and requires resilience from all.

The conditions, the unexpected and wholesome lifestyle NZ provides requires that the health of each
and every animal is critical to maintaining the well-being of the farm and vet practice. Working
together requires understanding, first a listening ear and then an active programme to maintain the
health of your production animals.

production, NZ vets and practices of all sizes as we're Kiwi owned and operated through and through

our great country.

# Help relieve osteoarthritis pain; for a week at a time.

The first and only weekly oral NSAID, for consistent OA pain and inflammation management.

 

[Learn more here][21]

# Animalcare is a development focused sales and marketing organisation.

Driven by a collective belief that healthy animals can have a hugely beneficial effect on their
owners and wider society.

[More about us][22]

# Equine by Animalcare. A dedicated product range for Equine veterinarians

Our Equine range offers a portfolio that is focused and committed to equine health by providing a
wide range of established healthcare products.

[More about us][23]

# Animalcare’s Practice Assistance Centre.
# A central hub supporting all of our practices.

The PAC is a free online practice support hub which hosts lots of great tools and materials for
practices.
The PAC is free to join and use. Explore it today.

[Log in to The PAC][24]

[Search icon]



#### Our Product Range

From Dental to OA – take a look at our innovative, high quality and excellent value products
available to the UK veterinary market.

[More information][25]



#### Online Learning

Animalcare have a collection of quality webinars, on a range of therapeutic areas, accessible to you
and your practice at a time convenient to you.

[More information][26]


#### Contact us

Whether you need to contact one of our nationally based Territory Sales Managers or need help from
our Tech support or Pharmacovigilance team; we are here to help.

[More information][27]


## Dedicated to Advancing Animal Health

For over 30 years, Animalcare has been a trusted partner to veterinary professionals across the UK,
providing high – quality animal health products and unwavering support. Our commitment goes beyond
products; it’s about fostering healthier animals, which in turn enrich the lives of their owners and
communities.

Driven by our core values – One Team, Integrity, Passion, Ownership, and Enjoyment – we strive to
make a positive impact every day. As part of the international Animalcare Group, we combine local
expertise with global innovation, ensuring that our solutions meet the evolving needs of the
veterinary field. Join us in our mission to enhance animal well-being and support the professionals
dedicated to their care.

## ACDIMA

As part of Arab joint action to encourage the pharmaceutical industry, the Arab Economic Unity
Council decided to establish an Arab institution capable of fulfilling this mission: the Arab
Company for Pharmaceutical Industries and Medical Supplies, "ACDIMA" on March 6, 1976, with an
initial capital of 60 million Kuwaiti Dinars. This capital was raised to 90 million Kuwaiti Dinars
with the approval of the extraordinary general assembly held in Amman, Jordan, on October 10, 2013,
in accordance with the Riyadh Declaration of 2013, which approved an increase of at least 50% in the
capital of joint Arab companies. The paid-up capital currently stands at 83,930,000 Kuwaiti Dinars.

# ACDIMA Bio Center

ACDIMA Center for bioequivalence and pharmaceutical studies is a contract research organization
based in Jordan. Established in 2000 to be one of the first BioCenters in Jordan with two decades of
experience and more than 750 bioequivalence studies to produce top-notch pharmaceutical solutions
around the world. With the increased demand for exceptional services, ACDIMA is striving to offer
extraordinary outcomes to maintain and exceed its spot as one of the best bioequivalence centers,
not only in Jordan, but in the whole region.

## ABOUT US

## Global Excellence in Animal Health

Bimeda develops and manufactures a wide range of veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines and animal
health products sold in more than eighty countries across six continents supporting livestock,
poultry, horses, companion animals and aquatic animals.

Founded in Ireland in 1960 and privately owned, Bimeda has grown into the 16th largest animal health
company in the world, with over 1,200 employees across 9 manufacturing facilities and 8 R&D
facilities globally.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2026 Annual Report

#### Grow *forward*

For generations, Cargill’s story has been rooted in growth — across oceans and continents, into new
products and innovative solutions, across supply chains and deeper in the communities we serve. But
the world we nourish tomorrow will demand a new kind of company. One that can more quickly turn the
power of insights, supply chains and capabilities into value for customers, when and how they need
it most. A partner that will listen intently, collaborate broadly and grow *forward*.

In Cargill’s 2026 Annual Report, we share how we’re preparing to navigate what comes next. Learn how
we are nourishing a changing world while helping farmers, customers and the hard-working people who
power our supply chains grow.

[Read the report][56]

[Sunflower close up with details.]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food

* 깨움
  
  새벽을 여는 종처럼, 우리는 깨워 왔습니다.
  그 어떤 도전도 두려워하지 않으며 이제까지 없었던 새로움을 깨워왔습니다.

  오늘도 더 큰 울림을 전하고 있습니다.

  과장하지 않아도, 화려하지 않아도
  가슴 속에 길게 여운을 남기는 종처럼
  
  당신의 건강한 삶에 평생을 함께하는, 긴 동반자가 되고 싶습니다.

products.name: Registered Vaccines
products.features: Range for the protection of poultry against various diseases including Infectious Coryza, Egg Drop Syndrome, Salmonella enterididis, Salmonella typhimurium and Pasteurella multocida.

products.name: Autogenous Vaccines
products.features: Custom, problem-specific vaccines intended for emergency and/or restricted use (time/locality), derived from specific pathogens isolated from a specific herd/flock of animals/birds and used under veterinary supervision in that specific herd/flock.

products.name: Aquamune
products.features: Autogenous vaccines for aquaculture, safeguarding aquaculture health and productivity.

products.name: AVIVAC
products.features: Cost-effective, science-driven vaccines designed to support effective disease control of poultry.

services.name: Research & Development
services.features: Development and evaluation of new and effective vaccines, with diagnostic tests for diseases affecting production animals.

services.name: Total Quality Management
services.features: Independent Quality Control and Quality Assurance department ensuring quality, safety, and consistency of all products and services, supported by ISO 9001 certification awarded by Bureau Veritas.

data.intel: Deltamune is a South African veterinary biotechnology company offering registered and autogenous vaccines for poultry, aquaculture, and production animals. It is ISO 9001 certified, emphasizes R&D and quality management, and is expanding into aquaculture with its Aquamune range. The partnership with Urban Farmer targets Africa's smallholder poultry sector, aligning with food security and sustainable agriculture trends. Potential growth drivers include increasing demand for animal protein and biosecurity solutions across Africa.

fornecer produtos e serviços para prevenir e tratar doenças em animais de produção e animais de
estimação, criando valor para pecuaristas, tutores, médicos-veterinários, técnicos e para a
sociedade como um todo.

### Nossos Produtos e Serviços

Na Elanco, nós desenvolvemos soluções inovadoras por meio dos nossos produtos e serviços, para
apoiar todas as pessoas que criam e cuidam dos animais a enfrentarem os desafios de um mundo em
constante mudança.

## O Propósito Saudável da Elanco (Elanco's Healthy Purpose™)

Nossa abordagem para a sustentabilidade é baseada em quatro pilares interligados, permitindo-nos
alcançar a nossa visão de alimentos e companheirismo enriquecendo a vida.
* Animais mais Saudáveis
* Pessoas mais Saudáveis
* Planeta mais Saudável
* Empresa mais Saudável

[Explore nosso Propósito Saudável][25]

### Liderança por meio da Inovação

O processo de pesquisa e desenvolvimento da Elanco aplica experiência e percepções baseadas em dados
para criar soluções para os desafios de saúde animal mais significativos.

[Vista de perto de pessoas segurando três ovos cada em suas mãos]
[Leia Mais][26]
[Vista de perto de pessoas segurando três ovos cada em suas mãos]

### Carreira na Elanco

Junte-se a nossa equipe engajada e motivada e venha descobrir como você pode fazer a diferença na
Elanco.

[Leia Mais][27]

### Nossa História

Nossa história abrange desde o desenvolvimento do nosso primeiro produto para bovinos em 1953, até
os tratamentos atuais, que contemplam também as necessidades de saúde de outros animais de produção
– suínos, aves e peixes – e dos animais de companhia.

I suoi prodotti sono esportati in oltre 90 Paesi. [ SCOPRI CHI SIAMO ][111] [fatroagenda] Fatroagenda del Veterinario Dal 1980 i riferimenti utili per la Veterinaria Italiana ed Europea. [ SCOPRI LA FONDAZIONE ][115] AMBIENTE ### Politiche Ambientali [ il nostro impegno ][116] Titolo di Default Testo di default BOTTONE ### News [ [FATRO ha acquisito la maggioranza di Günesli Aşı] ][117] ### [ FATRO ha acquisito la maggioranza di Günesli Aşı ][118] L’espansione dell’attività produttiva e commerciale nelle varie parti del mondo è l’obiettivo di FATRO che vede sempre più apprezzati i suoi prodotti ovunque. In quest’ottica FATRO ha recentemente acquisito la maggioranza di Günesli Aşı, azienda turca attiva nell’importazione di prodotti farmaceutici veterinari. Questo investimento rappresenta per FATRO un passo significativo nel rafforzamento della presenza diretta nel mercato turco, dove era già attiva tramite canali distributivi, consolidando così la propria posizione in un’area geografica chiave per il Mediterraneo orientale. Oltre alla Turchia, fanno parte del Gruppo FATRO aziende del settore in Polonia, Repubblica Ceca, Grecia, Spagna, Uruguay, Argentina e India. [ Leggi tutto ][119] [ [Nuova edizione: fresca di stampa la Fatroagenda 2026] ][120] ### [ Nuova edizione: fresca di stampa la Fatroagenda 2026 ][121] Anche quest’anno torna puntuale la Fatroagenda 2026, l’immancabile compagna di viaggio con i riferimenti utili della Veterinaria Italiana ed Europea. Più che una semplice agenda, è ormai diventata un vero e proprio simbolo di continuità, professionalità e appartenenza per chi lavora nel mondo veterinario. La prima edizione della Fatroagenda vide la luce nel lontano 1980: da allora, anno dopo anno, ha saputo conquistare sempre più spazio sulle scrivanie di veterinari e operatori del settore, diventando un punto di riferimento imprescindibile. Oggi, dopo oltre quarant’anni di storia, conserva intatto il suo valore e fascino, nonostante l’avvento dell’era digitale. Infatti è ancora richiestissima - un segno tangibile di quanto sia rimasto vivo il desiderio di sfogliare, annotare e consultare un oggetto che unisce tradizione, praticità e passione per la professione veterinaria. Per molti, non è soltanto un’agenda: è un pezzo di storia che ogni anno si rinnova, accompagnando la quotidianità di chi ha scelto di dedicare la propria vita alla cura e al benessere degli animali. Tradizione e innovazione si incontrano: la Fatroagenda è ora disponibile anche online, pronta ad accompagnare i professionisti della veterinaria in formato digitale. Per chi preferisce il digitale, la Fatroagenda è disponibile anche on-line. ACCEDI ALLA FATROAGENDA ON-LINESe hai dei suggerimenti per migliorare la Fatroagenda, ti chiediamo di compilare un semplice e veloce questionario, completamente anonimo. QUESTIONARIO FATROAGENDA [ Leggi tutto ][122] [ [Più benessere e meno antibiotici? Si può fare e conviene a tutti] ][123] ### [ Più benessere e meno antibiotici? Si può fare e conviene a tutti ][124] Carlo Gazza, figlio di allevatori di vacche da latte, un inizio di carriera come veterinario buiatra e poi una lunga militanza nell’azienda Farmaceutica Fatro, arrivando alla carica attuale di vice-presidente di Fatro Italia e Presidente di Fatro Iberica, la zootecnia da latte la conosce sicuramente da tante sfaccettature: dell’allevatore, del veterinario, del dirigente di una importante casa farmaceutica. Essendo poi di Parma, parlare di zootecnia da latte e pensare in primis al Parmigiano Reggiano è quasi inevitabile. Un formaggio che, anche decenni fa, veniva fatto con un latte di stalle dove l’attenzione a tanti dettagli di qualità era già più alta che nel resto della produzione da latte. “Ero probabilmente ancora al Liceo – ricorda Carlo Gazza – ma ho ben presente le scene che si potevano vedere la talvolta la sera al bar. Erano appena partiti i primi piani del Consorzio per la qualità del latte destinato a Parmigiano Reggiano. Si cominciavano a premiare miglioramenti della qualità, ad esempio per carica batterica, cellule somatiche, caseificabilità. E non era difficile imbattersi in dispute tra allevatori sul perché l’uno aveva un’alta carica batterica e su come e perché, ad esempio, sbagliasse a lavare la mungitrice. Discussioni a non finire, che si facevano anche assai animate, quasi fossero dispute calcistiche”. Da allora è passato tanto tempo, ma il lavoro per il miglioramento del latte destinato a Parmigiano Reggiano non è mai finito, anzi, si è arricchito via via di nuovi elementi. Però l’episodio da lei descritto indica una propensione, una cultura del miglioramento continuo che è connaturata agli allevatori da Parmigiano Reggiano. Quanto è importante questa cultura, anche alla luce delle sfide più immediate per il settore? Direi che è molto importante. Il miglioramento passa ancora soprattutto da una crescita culturale, che porta di conseguenza a una crescita tecnica. Questo vale a livello di stalle e di allevatori, ma anche di veterinari: il mondo del Parmigiano Reggiano ha una sua tipicità, una sua unicità nella zootecnia da latte. Bisogna capire sempre meglio questo e capire che anche la tecnica di allevamento, le scelte strutturali, la gestione, la sanità degli animali vanno affrontate in maniera specifica per stalle da Parmigiano Reggiano. Ripeto, vale per gli allevatori, ma anche per i veterinari: lo sforzo deve essere quello di capire meglio cosa c’è dietro al problema quando esso si manifesta, per riuscire a prevenirlo prima di essere costretto a curarlo. Confesso che un mio sogno nel cassetto è un Master Fatro proprio per veterinari da Parmigiano Reggiano. Anche perché i tempi del farmaco – e in particolare dell’antibiotico – che rimedia ad eventuali errori in qualche fase dell’allevamento sono finiti. Stiamo entrando, a questo riguardo, in un vero e proprio cambio di paradigma. Se poi ci mettiamo l’imperativo del benessere animale lo scenario dell’allevamento cambierà radicalmente. Poi parleremo di questo. Ma prima vorrei chiederle come tutto questo ha un impatto su una grande azienda farmaceutica, che – ovviamente – fa anche della vendita di farmaci una questione di business. Naturalmente non posso che parlare per conto di Fatro. Ebbene, per noi quello che oggi si sta materializzando, con la spinta a consumare meno antibiotici e a migliorare fortemente il benessere animale, non è certo una rivoluzione, ma la naturale conseguenza di un cambio di prospettiva industriale iniziato fin dai tempi della crisi della vacca pazza. Fu la prima scossa grave al sistema zootecnico per come era andato definendosi fino ad allora, verso la sempre maggiore intensivizzazione. Allora decidemmo di dare una svolta alla nostra attività puntando su un modello più in linea con le esigenze di benessere degli animali e sul consapevole uso del farmaco, lavorando anche per comunicare meglio questo approccio. Ora questo cambio di scenario non ci trova impreparati, tutt’altro. Qualche esempio? Per stare sulle iniziative più recenti, abbiamo creato da alcuni anni proprio una Linea Benessere che riguarda – ovviamente – il curare gli animali al meglio, perché il benessere è in primo luogo curare un animale malato. Ma nello specifico l’obiettivo è anche quello di rendere meno dolorose certe pratiche. Ad esempio, per la decornazione del vitello abbiamo un programma che prevede l’utilizzo di un anestetico al momento della decornazione e in contemporanea di un antidolorifico che permette al vitello di stare molto meglio e di non subire traumi. Se passiamo al tema della riduzione del consumo di antibiotici, da un paio d’anni offriamo come servizio un test rapido da camp

Thành phần là kháng thể đặc hiệu hàm lượng cao dùng phòng gà trị bệnh tiêu chảy, sưng phù đầu do *Escherichia coli* và bệnh viêm ruột hoại tử do *Clostridium perfringens* gây ra cho lợn con. HANVET KTE Hi PLUS có tác dụng nhanh, mạnh, đặc hiệu giúp trung hòa (tiêu diệt) tác nhân gây bệnh, giúp phòng và trị bệnh do *E. coli* và *C. perfringens* an toàn, hiệu quả. **CHỈ ĐỊNH** Phòng và điều trị cho lợn mắc bệnh tiêu chảy, sưng phù đầu do *E. coli* và bệnh viêm ruột hoại tử *C.perfringens.* **CÁCH DÙNG VÀ LIỀU LƯỢNG** - Để kháng thể ra ngoài nhiệt độ phòng 15-30 phút cho hết lạnh trước khi sử dụng. Phòng bệnh: Dùng cho lợn uống vào lúc sơ sinh, tốt nhất là trong vòng 24 giờ đầu sau sinh, càng sớm càng tốt với liều 1-3 ml/con. Nhắc lại lúc lợn 3 ngày tuổi, 10 ngày tuổi cùng với lịch tiêm sắt. Chữa bệnh: Nếu bệnh nhẹ thì nên cho uống, chỉ tiêm phúc xoang **(không tiêm bắp thịt)** khi lợn bị bệnh nặng với các triệu chứng như: sưng hầu, lạc giọng, phù mắt, phù đầu… với liều 0,3-0,5 ml/kg thể trọng, tối thiểu 1 ml/con, liệu trình mỗi ngày 1 lần, liên tục 3-4 ngày. **LƯU Ý KHI SỬ DỤNG:** - Các dụng cụ tiếp xúc trực tiếp với kháng thể phải được tiệt trùng bằng nhiệt rồi để nguội trước khi dùng, không dùng các hóa chất để sát khuẩn. - Kiểm tra kỹ lô kháng thể trước khi sử dụng. Không dùng các chai đã nứt vỡ, hở, có dị vật, tạp chất ở trong; nhãn mờ nhòe, hết hạn sử dụng, bị phơi nắng hay để ở nhiệt độ không đúng quy định. - Chai kháng thể đã cắm kim chỉ sử dụng trong ngày (12 giờ). - Kháng thể bản chất là protein nên khi đưa vào cơ thể lợn có thể xảy ra các phản ứng quá mẫn. Khi có phản ứng xảy ra, tiêm ngay **Cafein **và **Atropin **(hoặc **Adrenaline**) kết hợp xoa bóp, dội nước lạnh cho lợn tỉnh. Có thể tiêm truyền phúc xoang bổ sung dung dịch sinh lý ngọt (**Glucose 5%**) để trợ sức. **THỜI GIAN NGƯNG SỬ DỤNG THUỐC:** Không **BẢO QUẢN:** 2^{o}-8^{o}C, không được để đông đá, tránh ánh sáng trực tiếp. **HẠN DÙNG:** Xem trên bao bì sản phẩm. **QUY CÁCH ĐÓNG GÓI:** Lọ 10 ml, 20 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml. [ ### Kháng thể K.T.DOG CARE-PAR ][91] Kháng thể phòng và trị bệnh care và parvo ở chó [XEM NHANH ][92] ###### Kháng thể K.T.DOG CARE-PAR **THÀNH PHẦN** - Hàm lượng kháng thể mỗi loại như sau: + Kháng thể đặc hiệu kháng Canine Distemper virus: ≥ 8 log2 VNT + Kháng thể đặc hiệu kháng Canine Parvo virus: ≥ 9 log2 VNT + Chất ổn định vừa đủ **ĐẶC TÍNH KỸ THUẬT** - Hanvet K.T.Dog Care-Par là chế phẩm sinh học độc đáo, sản xuất theo công nghệ tiên tiến, hiện đại, đạt tiêu chuẩn GMP- WHO. - Thành phần là kháng thể đặc hiệu hàm lượng cao, giúp phòng và điều trị bệnh Parvo (viêm ruột – dạ dày) và bệnh Care (sài sốt) ở chó. - Hanvet K.T.Dog Care-Par có tác dụng nhanh, mạnh, đặc hiệu giúp trung hòa (tiêu diệt) virus gây bệnh Care và Parvo giúp phòng và trị bệnh an toàn, hiệu quả. **CHỈ ĐỊNH** - Phòng và điều trị bệnh Care và Parvo cho chó ở mọi lứa tuổi. **CÁCH DÙNG VÀ LIỀU DÙNG** - Để thuốc hết lạnh, lắc kỹ trước khi sử dụng - Tiêm bắp hoặc tiêm dưới da với liệu trình như sau: * Phòng bệnh: Trong trường hợp chó không có kháng thể thụ động từ mẹ truyền qua sữa đầu hoặc trường hợp tăng nguy cơ nhiễm trùng (vd: chó tham gia triển lãm, trong quá trình vận chuyển,…) Tiêm 0,5 - 1 ml/2 - 3 kg thể trọng. Tiêm nhắc lại sau 5 ngày nếu cần thiết cho đến khi chó ra khỏi khu vực có nguy cơ nhiễm trùng. * Trị bệnh: Tiêm 1 ml/ 2 - 3 kg thể trọng. Tối thiểu 1 ml/con. Ngày 1 lần, liên tục trong 3 - 4 ngày. Nên dùng kết hợp Hanvet K.T.Dog Care-Par với truyền dịch và các thuốc trợ sức, trợ lực để nâng cao hiệu quả điều trị. Lưu ý: Tiêm vắc xin phòng bệnh Care và Parvo sau khi sử dụng Hanvet K.T.Dog Care-Par lần cuối 7 - 10 ngày. **CHỐNG CHỈ ĐỊNH** - Chó đang ốm **CHÚ Ý KHI SỬ DỤNG** - Kháng thể phải luôn được bảo quản đúng điều kiện quy đinh - Kiểm tra kỹ lô kháng thể trước khi sử dụng. - Sử dụng dụng cụ tiêm vô khuẩn. **THỜI GIAN NGƯNG SỬ DỤNG THUỐC:** Không **BẢO QUẢN VÀ HẠN SỬ DỤNG:** - Bảo quản ở 2^{o}C - 8^{o}C, tránh ánh sáng trực tiếp. Hạn dùng 18 tháng **QUY CÁCH ĐÓNG GÓI:** - Lọ 3 ml, 5 ml, 10 ml, 20 ml, 50 ml [ ### VẮC XIN PARVO ][93] **Vắc xin vô hoạt phòng bệnh viên ruột hoại tử trên chó do Parvo virus gây ra** [XEM NHANH ][94] ###### VẮC XIN PARVO **THÀNH PHẦN:** * Mỗi liều vắc xin chứa: * Kháng nguyên vi rút Parvo trước vô hoạt: ≥ 10^{5.}^{3 }TCID50 * Bổ trợ vắc xin: vừa đủ **ĐẶC TÍNH KỸ THUẬT** * **Vắc xin Parvo** là vắc xin vô hoạt sử dụng chủng vi rút Parvo cường độc phân lập từ thực địa Việt Nam. Vắc xin kích thích gây phản ứng miễn dịch học, tạo kháng thể chủ động cho chó được chủng ngừa, giúp chó phòng bệnh viêm ruột hoại tử do Parvovirus cường độc gây ra. **CHỈ ĐỊNH: **Dùng tiêm phòng cho chó khỏe mạnh từ 6 tuần tuổi. **CÁCH DÙNG VÀ LIỀU DÙNG** * Để lọ vắc xin ra ngoài nhiệt độ phòng 10 – 15 phút cho hết lạnh. * Lắc đều lọ vắc xin trước khi sử dụng. * Tiêm dưới da liều 1ml/con * ***Tiêm phòng cho chó theo chỉ dẫn sau*** * Tiêm mũi 01: khi chó được 6 đến 8 tuần tuổi * Tiêm mũi 02: tiêm cách mũi 01 từ 14 đến 21 ngày. * Tiêm nhắc lại mỗi năm một lần **CHỐNG CHỈ ĐỊNH: **Chó đang bị ốm. **CHÚ Ý KHI SỬ DỤNG VẮC XIN** * Các dụng cụ tiêm phòng phải được tiệt trùng bằng nhiệt, không dùng các hóa chất sát trùng để sát trùng các dụng cụ tiếp xúc trực tiếp với vắc xin. * Chai vắc xin sau khi đâm kim nên được sử dụng hết. * Kiểm tra kỹ lô vắc xin trước khi sử dụng. Căn cứ vào số liều ghi trên nhãn chai vắc xin để pha sao cho mỗi liều có thể tích 2ml. Tiêm dưới da hoặc bắp thịt mỗi con 1 liều vắc xin. **CHỐNG CHỈ ĐỊNH:** Lợn đang bị ốm. **CHÚ Ý KHI SỬ DỤNG VẮC XIN** Trước và sau khi tiêm vắc xin 1 tuần, không sử dụng bất kỳ loại kháng sinh nào cho lợn. # Better health for human beings through healthier animals

## Building the Future on a Foundation of Excellence

Hester Biosciences Limited is one of India’s leading animal healthcare companies and is the second
largest poultry vaccine manufacturer in the country. Founded by Mr. Rajiv Gandhi, Hester began its
journey in 1987. Over the years, it has transformed from a small proprietary trading business into
Asia’s largest one-stop animal biological manufacturing facility. We now have a strategic presence
in over 35+ countries, while focusing on key market needs in India, Nepal and Tanzania. We have also
partnered with various organisations over the years including Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation,
GALVmed, Golchha Organisation, and our latest foray into the Egyptian market with Novapharma, to
name a few.

data.intel: Meiji Seika Pharma is the pharmaceutical arm of Meiji Holdings, emphasizing infectious disease treatment and generic drug supply. Its partnership with KM Biologics covers both prevention (vaccines) and treatment (antibiotics), creating a comprehensive infection control portfolio. The company is leveraging subsidiaries such as Me Pharma, Meiji Seika Pharma Tech, and Medreich in India to ensure stable supply and improve global access to medicines. Drug discovery research with universities aims at extending healthy life expectancy worldwide.

desde cuidados dos pets até aspectos-chave da produção animal.

## A Ciência para Animais Mais Saudáveis™

Somos impulsionados por desafios, inovamos em ciência para promover melhoria contínua em saúde e
bem-estar animal.

## Nossas Pessoas São Nosso Diferencial

São elas que, diariamente, nos ajudam a executar o nosso propósito de “melhorar a vida das pessoas e
a saúde e bem-estar dos animais”. Por isso, investimentos no desenvolvimento e capacitação de nossos
colaboradores, valorizando a construção de uma equipe que trabalha com dedicação e excelência, por
meio da liderança positiva. Tamanha dedicação tem resultado em reconhecimento: em 2019, fomos
eleitos, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no setor, de acordo com o
guia Você S/A

## Saúde Única

Acreditamos que garantir saúde, sustentabilidade e bem-estar da produção animal beneficia a todos.
Afinal, a saúde humana e animal estão diretamente ligadas. É por isso que somos um alicerce da
filosofia “One Health”, que trabalha para a integração as saúde dos animais, pessoas e do ambiente.

## Nota Oficial

Medicamentos de saúde animal não devem ser utilizados para tratamento humano.

[saiba mais][22]

Somos uma empresa global centrada na investigação e desenvolvimento, fabrico e comercialização de

[Learn more][122] ## Education and CE opportunities for animal health professionals Access learning designed to support your career, your practice, and better outcomes. Browse upcoming events, webinars, on-demand sessions, surgical education from Securos University, and practical articles from MWI Animal Health — all in one place. [ View learning opportunities ][123] [Female veterinarian examining cat on examination table in clinic with cat's owner] # **New World screwworm: What you need to know** Confirmed cases of New World screwworm in the southern U.S. highlight the need for proactive monitoring, strong biosecurity, and rapid response to protect animal health. [ Explore NWS resources ][124] [Dairy-Jersey2] Now available! ## Hassle-free Rx management with Furscription Manage all online and local pharmacy requests in one platform. Reclaim your time with AI-driven tools that simplify prescription management. [ Get started now ][125] [Female veterinarian holding a schnauzer in her arms while standing in her office.] ## Protect your practice with our equipment health solution Reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and save money with smarter equipment care Equipment downtime doesn’t just delay appointments—it impacts patient safety, client trust, and your bottom line. Our equipment health solution makes it easy to manage all your equipment in one place. [ Explore our equipment health solution ][126] [Vet tech putting IV in a cat's leg] # Creating a brighter future for animal health Born from one veterinarian's vision for better access to essential medications and solutions, we are more than just a distribution company—we are a catalyst for change. With a bold commitment to "thinking forward," we collaborate with veterinarians and producers to tackle inefficiencies and innovate solutions that enhance animal care and profitability. Our technology and partnerships empower those who keep animals healthy. Join us as we redefine the future of animal health, creating healthier lives for all. Let’s think forward together! ## We make your business our business Equipping you with the products, insights and resources to meet the unique needs of your operation ### Companion animal and livestock veterinarians [ Learn more ][127] [Veterinary clinic lobby] ### Equine veterinarians [ Learn more ][128] [Equine veterinarian with horse patient] ### Cattle producers [ Learn more ][129] [Cattle producers looking at a tablet in a cattle yard] ### Swine producers [ Learn more ][130] [Pig's face] ### Ag retailers [ Learn more ][131] [Ag retail business] ### Manufacturers [ Learn more ][132] [Ag retail business] [Man using his computer with a cat on his keyboard] Products ## Everything you need, right at your fingertips [Man using his computer with a cat on his keyboard] Get the products, supplies and equipment your animal health business needs at anytime, from anywhere. [ Learn more about our product offering ][133] [ Log in and shop ][134] [Man using his computer with a cat on his keyboard] Solutions and services ## Whatever challenges your business is facing, we can face them with you and help you solve them. Our solutions and services are designed to help you in every aspect of your business, from providing top-notch animal care and customer service to managing day-to-day operations. [ Explore solutions ][135] [Woman working at a desk with a tablet and computer] ## Our brands Through our role in animal health, we support the mental health benefits we receive from our pets and the wholesome protein we receive from sustainable food production. Tens of thousands of healthcare providers, veterinary practices and livestock producers trust us as their partner in the pharmaceutical supply chain. [ Log in and shop Cencora ][136] [Pharmacist selecting a product from a shelf] [Securos Surgical logo] For over 20 years, Securos Surgical has designed quality surgical products and services to help you provide your patients with the best possible care. Trust Securos for innovation, quality and value — all delivered with the industry’s most personalized service. [ Log in and shop Securos ][137] [Securos Surgical scissors] [VetOne Logo] VetOne was brought to market by MWI in 2005 to provide superior value and quality products to veterinarians throughout the nation. Today, VetOne's partnership with MWI has allowed continued growth because we know that we won't be successful unless our customers are, and we continue to develop solutions centered on their success. [ Log in and shop VetOne ][138] [Veterinarian looking at a tablet with a Dalmatian] Publications and Insights ## Expertise you can trust Our collection of publications and articles is designed to deliver information and insights that are relevant to your operation. [Messenger Focus magazine covers] ### Messenger Focus [Messenger Focus magazine covers] *Messenger Focus* is our seasonally distributed publication focusing on themes specific to your industry and serving as a valuable resource for you and your team to reference throughout the year. [ Explore recent issues ][139] [Messenger Focus magazine covers] ### Latest Insights Insight ### How to streamline prescription workflows with myAnimalRx MWI Animal Health MWI Animal Health August 2026 [ Learn more ][140] Insight ### The right distributor expands what is possible in veterinary medicine MWI Animal Health MWI Animal Health August 2026 [ Learn more ][141] Insight ### The hidden costs of neglecting swine water line maintenance MWI Animal Health MWI Animal Health August 2026 [ Learn more ][142] [ View all Insights articles ][143] ## Get updates in your inbox [ Subscribe ][144] Careers ## Be a part of our team and help us create a healthier world for people and animals Join us on our mission to make a meaningful impact in the lives of people and animals worldwide. At our company, you'll find a dynamic and supportive environment where your talents can thrive. Explore our diverse career opportunities and become a vital part of a team that values innovation, passion, and growth. Together, we can achieve remarkable things. [ Find your next career ][145] ## Let's work together We are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and we value your partnership on that journey. We look forward to exploring the ways we can make a difference for your business. 化学の力で新たな価値を創造し、
社会の発展に貢献する。

日本曹達は1920年の創立以来、
「化学」を通じて新たな価値を世の中に提供し、
社会の発展に貢献してまいりました。
当社グループは、さまざまな化学製品・サービスで
人々の暮らしを支えてまいります。

[ Our Impact ][163] ##### **Norbrook at a Glance** ### Entrepreneurial spirit, global reach Established in 1969 in Newry, Northern Ireland, UK, by the late Lord Ballyedmond, Norbrook is one of the largest, family owned, veterinary pharmaceutical companies in the world. * Manufacturer of large & companion animal veterinary products * 5 manufacturing sites globally * 3000+ product registrations * Exports to 100+ countries [ Our History ][164] Independent Family owned, Animal Health Company Global footprint Manufacturer of differentiated, generic animal health pharmaceuticals Leading edge innovation ## Global Presence, Local Expertise Northern Ireland Republic of Ireland Great Britain Europe MENA United States Australia New Zealand East Africa Latin America [Northern Ireland] [Northern Ireland] [Northern Ireland] [Republic of Ireland] [Republic of Ireland] [Republic of Ireland] [Great Britain ] [Great Britain ] [Great Britain ] [Europe ] [Europe ] [Europe ] [MENA ] [MENA ] [MENA ] [United States] [United States] [United States] [Australia ] [Australia ] [Australia ] [New Zealand ] [New Zealand ] [New Zealand ] [East Africa ] [East Africa ] [East Africa ] [Latin America ] [Latin America ] [Latin America ] ##### **Northern Ireland** ## The home of Norbrook It is from Northern Ireland that Norbrook originated and started our global journey. Today, we manufacture differentiated, generic animal health pharmaceuticals from three world-class production facilities in Northern Ireland. ##### **Republic of Ireland** ## The go-to animal health company Norbrook sells a full complement of companion animal and farm animal products in Ireland and almost every farm in Ireland would use Norbrook's best-selling brands. We support our customers with nation wide field-based sales and expert veterinarian teams. ##### **Great Britain ** ## A trusted partner to the GB animal health industry since 1969 Our UK subsidiary is based in Leicestershire, and we have field-based teams throughout the UK offering technical support and educational training to our customers. Several of Norbrook’s brands occupy leading market shares. ##### **Europe** ## A top quality supplier across the EU Norbrook products are widely distributed throughout Europe and occupy leading market shares in several markets. In Europe, we work with longstanding distributor partners who are supported by Norbrook’s in-country commercial area managers. ##### **MENA ** ## Building on decades of success in MENA Norbrook is a well-known and established brand across the MENA region most notably in Egypt, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Algeria. Our key focus in MENA is on our large animal portfolio which is distributed via in-country partners. ##### **United States** ## Providing quality, affordable animal health products to the US veterinary community Norbrook first exported to the US in 1988 and it is now our largest market. Our operations and commercial teams are located at our head office in Lenexa, Kansas where our extensive warehousing facilities are also based. The US is core to our growth ambitions, and we are rapidly expanding our large and companion animal product portfolio with new product launches. ##### **Australia ** ## Professional support to the Australian animal health industry Norbrook’s Australian subsidiary is based in Victoria. Our field-based teams provide technical support and educational training for national customers. We continue to expand our portfolio, launching innovative products to help our customers grow their business. ##### **New Zealand** ## Committed to the health & wellbeing of animals Customers in New Zealand are supported by Norbrook’s in-market commercial representatives and through our Australian subsidiary. We offer a focused portfolio for companion and large animal products including a comprehensive intramamaries range. ##### **East Africa** ## Leading the market in Kenya and Uganda Norbrook first established a manufacturing facility in Kenya in 1993 and we are now the No. 1 animal healthcare company in Kenya. Our Kenyan facility is complemented by a sales and marketing office in Uganda which also supports exports to a range of countries on the African continent. ##### **Latin America ** ## Supporting the expanding animal health market Norbrook service the growing Latin American animal health industry through distributor partnerships. We have a particular focus on Brazil's billion-dollar industry due to the size of the cattle population and its booming companion animal sector. ##### **Life at Norbrook** ## Passionate about improving animals lives Discover careers and opportunities at Norbrook [Join Us][165] "My role as a GMP auditor constantly evolves as the Pharmaceutical industry regulations update. [Let’s Do More Together][133] Pause ## Intelligent Nutrition for Your Business Global scientific research with local insights for your business. Our global reach and inclusive culture mean we understand the complex challenges protein producers face around the globe, and we help apply those learnings locally. We consider the big picture and gain insight into the complexities of your operation and the world at large. Intelligent nutrition isn’t just about feeding healthy animals. It’s about feeding business. Feeding sustainability. Feeding future generations. We bring it all together to inspire producers to build the best version of their business. A business that works smarter. ## NOVUS is MADE OF MORE™ Our company slogan represents the focus of all NOVUS endeavors. At NOVUS, we are dedicated to helping agriculture animals reach their full potential. This is possible through a combination of intelligent nutrition and extensive research, both internally and with partners around the world, along with expert consulting, educational programs and individualized training services. Our teams provide specialized consulting and services tailored to the industry’s unique challenges, with a focus on improving animal nutrition, health, and overall production efficiency. Our product research and development services support poultry, swine, and dairy producers in adopting science-based solutions for animal nutrition and management. Through our partnerships, we equip producers, nutritionists, and agricultural professionals with the latest insights and best practices in animal agriculture to help them get more from their animals. [A lab worker holding a beaker][A lab worker holding a beaker] ## Learn More About Partnering with NOVUS Whether you’re working directly with us or partnering with us to deliver to your clients, our goal is the same, to be a true partner. Our devotion to our customers is unmatched. We go beyond products with comprehensive services designed to help customers elevate their operations. [Contact Us][134] ## Advanced Technology, Rooted in Scientific Research Increased animal health and performance from innovative, scientifically proven products based on decades of leadership. We believe we have a social, environmental, and economic obligation to deliver products, services, and programs that ensure a sustainable future for all of us. [Learn how we drive sustainability][138] ## Commitment to Innovation Innovation is at our core. As scientists and entrepreneurs, we’re driven to create new ideas that improve the health of your animals and your business. # Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

Våra veterinära läkemedel finns på apotek eller skrivs ut av veterinär. Våra produkter för lantbruket säljs hos jakt- och lantbruksbutiker samt i e-handel. Vi har väletablerade samarbeten med ett flertal leverantörer både i Norden och norra Europa. Tillsammans med våra leverantörer utvecklar vi och förädlar vårt sortiment av egna varumärken eller distribuerar leverantörernas. [Läs mer här][114] ## Vår Affärside Vi utvecklar, distribuerar och marknadsför starka varumärken och kvalitetsprodukter som ger ökad hälsa och välbefinnande för människor och djur samtidigt som de skapar ekonomiskt värde för Pharmaxim och våra samarbetspartners. ## Vår affärsmodell Pharmaxim är främst varumärkesägare men distribuerar även andra företags varumärken. Vi fördrar då en exklusiv distributörsmodell där Pharmaxim sköter allt från marknadsföring och försäljning till kundtjänst och logistik genom eget lager från vilket vi levererar kundanpassat gods till såväl enskilda butiker som till större centrallager i Norden. Vi väljer hållbara, kvalitets/miljöcertifierade och närbelägna tillverkare av de produkter som ingår i vår varumärkesportfölj. Många av våra leverantörer tillverkar i Sverige eller något Nordiskt land. Vi betraktar Norden som vår hemmamarknad och vi säljer till slutkund genom grossister och detaljister i alla relevanta kanaler. ## Våra Kunder Pharmaxims Human Health produkter finns i alla relevanta kanaler från dagligvaruhandel och lågprishandel till Apotek och e-handel. Våra veterinära läkemedel finns på apotek eller skrivs ut av veterinär. Våra Animal Health produkter säljs i butiker som vänder sig till lantbrukare, jägare och djurägare samt i bygghandel och e-handel. Men de finns även hos grossister till professionella djurhållningsföretag. Pharmaxim är väl förtrogna med alla regelverk som gäller för vårt sortiment. # Versorgt
# mit Vorsprung

[Zum Imagevideo][38]

## Uns liegt die Gesundheit von Mensch & Tier am Herzen. Immer schon!

So hat sich im Laufe von vier Jahrhunderten aus einer Apotheke am Welser Stadtplatz ein **weltweit
erfolgreiches Pharmaunternehmen** entwickelt. Heute positioniert sich Richter Pharma durch sein
maximales Spektrum an Gesundheitsdienstleistungen als vielfältiger Anbieter am Markt.

Von der GMP-konformen Produktion über den klassischen, vollsortierten Humanpharmahandel, die
Marktführerschaft am österreichischen Veterinärgroßhandelssektor bis hin zur Logistikdienstleistung
für die Pharmaindustrie profitieren alle unsere Kunden von einem **umfassenden Pharma-Know How
entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette**.

Mit dem Leitmotiv **„Versorgt mit Vorsprung“** legen wir unseren strategischen Schwerpunkt auf die
Entwicklung von innovativen Produkten und Dienstleistungen im Gesundheitsbereich.

## Der Pharmahandel mit dem gewissen Extra!

Als **vollsortierter Pharmahandel** bieten wir die österreichweit flächendeckende Distribution an
öffentliche Apotheken, hausapothekenführende Ärzte und Krankenanstalten.

Mit mehr als hundert Jahren Pharmakompetenz sind wir ein **unersetzliches Glied in der
Arzneimittelversorgung** und sichern, dass die Arzneimittel vor Ort sind, wenn sie rasch und
dringend benötigt werden.

**Innovative Dienstleistungen wie die patientenindividuelle Verblisterung** von Arzneimitteln unter
GMP-konformen Bedingungen können durch die Synergien mit der [MEDventuro GmbH][43], an der Richter
Pharma zu 1/3 beteiligt ist, first class angeboten werden.

[Mehr erfahren...][44]

## Ihr erster Ansprechpartner für Tiergesundheit!

Als **marktführender Veterinärpharmahandel in Österreich** sind wir Ihr **erster Ansprechpartner**,
egal ob Sie uns als **Tierarzt oder Tierärztin oder als Industriepartner** Ihre Anliegen
kommunizieren. Von der reinen Logistikdienstleistung bis hin zur exklusiven Zusammenarbeit bieten
wir **für alle Industriepartner die richtige Lösung**.

Beginnend bereits beim Studium, über den Praxisbeginn, bis hin zur ständigen Weiterbildung begleiten
wir alle unsere Veterinärkunden in Österreic

## Gesund­heit für Mensch und Tier

Die **Serumwerk Bernburg AG** ist ein mit­tel­stän­di­sches phar­ma­zeu­ti­sches Unter­neh­men mit einer über
60-jährigen Tradition in der Ent­wick­lung und Pro­duk­ti­on von Arz­nei­mit­teln, Medi­zin­pro­duk­ten sowie
Wirk­stof­fen.

Neben unseren bekannten Mar­ken­pro­duk­ten Pulmotin® Erkäl­tungs­sal­be, Pyolysin® Wund- und Heilsalbe und
Par­odon­tal® Mundsalbe nimmt auch die Vete­ri­när­me­di­zin einen hohen Stel­len­wert ein. Mit der
Bereit­stel­lung hoch­wer­ti­ger Tier­arz­nei­mit­tel zur Therapie und Pro­phy­la­xe von Erkran­kun­gen bei Nutz-
und Klein­tie­ren sowie Care-Produkten bieten wir dem Anwender eine breite Pro­dukt­pa­let­te zur
Sicherung der Tier­ge­sund­heit.

Zudem hat sich die Serumwerk Bernburg AG in den letzten Jahren verstärkt der Ent­wick­lung von hoch
inno­va­ti­ven Produkten auf der Basis natür­li­cher Bio­po­ly­me­re sowie eines Eisen­prä­pa­ra­tes zur
Anämie­pro­phy­la­xe gewidmet, die eine inter­na­tio­na­le Spit­zen­stel­lung einnehmen und die gemeinsam mit
aus­ge­wähl­ten Partnern weltweit ver­mark­tet werden.

Unser Kern­ge­schäft basiert auf der Pro­duk­ti­on am Standort Deutsch­land, dadurch sichern wir hohe
Qua­li­täts­stan­dards und regionale Arbeits­plät­ze. Den Produkten für Mensch und Tier „Made in Germany“
vertrauen seit Jahr­zehn­ten weltweit unsere Ver­triebs­part­ner in mehr als 60 Ländern.

## Serumwerk Bernburg AG

Das Serumwerk Bernburg wurde bereits 1954 gegründet und im Jahr 1992 zur Aktiengesellschaft
privatisiert. In dieser Zeit entwickelte sich die Unternehmensgruppe zu einem weltweit anerkannten
Produzenten und Lieferanten von Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten für die Human- und
Veterinärmedizin.

Zudem hat sich die Serumwerk Bernburg AG in den letzten Jahren verstärkt der Ent­wick­lung von hoch inno­va­ti­ven Produkten auf der Basis natür­li­cher Bio­po­ly­me­re sowie eines Eisen­prä­pa­ra­tes zur Anämie­pro­phy­la­xe gewidmet, die eine inter­na­tio­na­le Spit­zen­stel­lung einnehmen und die gemeinsam mit aus­ge­wähl­ten Partnern weltweit ver­mark­tet werden. Unser Kern­ge­schäft basiert auf der Pro­duk­ti­on am Standort Deutsch­land, dadurch sichern wir hohe Qua­li­täts­stan­dards und regionale Arbeits­plät­ze. Den Produkten für Mensch und Tier „Made in Germany“ vertrauen seit Jahr­zehn­ten weltweit unsere Ver­triebs­part­ner in mehr als 60 Ländern. ## Serumwerk Bernburg AG Das Serumwerk Bernburg wurde bereits 1954 gegründet und im Jahr 1992 zur Aktiengesellschaft privatisiert. In dieser Zeit entwickelte sich die Unternehmensgruppe zu einem weltweit anerkannten Produzenten und Lieferanten von Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten für die Human- und Veterinärmedizin. ## A Ciência para Animais Mais Saudáveis™

Somos impulsionados por desafios, inovamos em ciência para promover melhoria contínua em saúde e
bem-estar animal.

## Nossas Pessoas São Nosso Diferencial

São elas que, diariamente, nos ajudam a executar o nosso propósito de “melhorar a vida das pessoas e
a saúde e bem-estar dos animais”. Por isso, investimentos no desenvolvimento e capacitação de nossos
colaboradores, valorizando a construção de uma equipe que trabalha com dedicação e excelência, por
meio da liderança positiva. Tamanha dedicação tem resultado em reconhecimento: em 2019, fomos
eleitos, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no setor, de acordo com o
guia Você S/A

## Saúde Única

Acreditamos que garantir saúde, sustentabilidade e bem-estar da produção animal beneficia a todos.
Afinal, a saúde humana e animal estão diretamente ligadas. É por isso que somos um alicerce da
filosofia “One Health”, que trabalha para a integração as saúde dos animais, pessoas e do ambiente.

## Nota Oficial

Medicamentos de saúde animal não devem ser utilizados para tratamento humano.

# **COATEX**®

**COATEX**® is a veterinary-recommended range designed to support normal skin function and help
maintain a healthy coat.

Developed to provide both nutritional and topical care, the **COATEX**® range includes products
formulated to help maintain the skin’s natural barrier and overall coat condition. The new
**COATEX**® Shampoos offers gentle cleansing to support skin hygiene and coat quality, making them
suitable for regular use, including in pets with sensitive skin.

**COATEX**® can be used as part of a wider approach to skin and coat care, helping to maintain
comfort and condition in dogs and cats.

Nutraceuticals are supplements made from natural ingredients that provide health benefits beyond
basic nutrition. They’re often used to support specific areas of your pet’s health - like joints,

form of powders, liquids, tablets, or capsules, nutraceuticals are designed to work alongside a
balanced diet, to help support overall wellness. Think of them as a way to give your pet a little
extra care, naturally and safely.

# The family business

Veyx-Pharma is a medium-sized family-owned veterinary pharmaceutical enterprise based in Germany.
Since its inception in 1984, our company focuses on preventive health maintenance and the ensured
performance of farm animals and pets. This concept defers from the traditional mindset of only
treating sick animals.

We also work on customized solutions for therapy. Our products and range of services equal the the
consumer request for residue-free and riskfree food of animal origin. We also offer products for
horses and pets.

## Research in focus

Research and development are the most important areas for our company. Our scientific department
maintains a close relationship with universities and research facilities in Germany and abroad. The
intensive contact to agriculture and animal holders creates products that are needed in practice.

Veyx-Pharma ensures the effectiveness, quality and safety of products with responsible and
consequent controlling. Production takes place in GMP-certified production facilities with modern
standards.

### Quality as top priority

Veyx-Pharma is QS- and VLOG-system partner. Accordingly, complementary feeds and complementary feeds
with particular nutritional purposes are QS-certified and VLOG-approved.

## Veyx is a registered brand:

Veterinary pharmaceuticals, complementary feeds/complementary feeds with particular nutritional
purposes and animal care products: these product groups are easily distinguishable by their
different designs and brands.

Complementary feeds/complementary feeds with particular nutritional purposes have the umbrella brand
**VeyFo®**.

Animal care products unify under the umbrella brand **SanDitan®**.

Veterinary pharmaceuticals have** individual brands**.

### Veyx International

Over the years, the enterprise has become a more and more internationally operating group. Today,
this group with their headquarters in Schwarzenborn, Germany, comprises own manufacturing plants for
active ingredients, various pharmaceutical forms as well as world wide distibution.

Veyx-products are approved for marketing from Chile to China, from Canada to Egypt in more than 60
countries. Veyx-Pharma has subsidiaries in Bulgaria, the Netherlands, Poland and Slovakia.

# Das Familienunternehmen

Veyx-Pharma ist ein mittelständisches, deutsches, veterinärpharmazeutisches Familienunternehmen.
Seit der Firmengründung 1984 liegt der Schwerpunkt in der vorbeugenden Gesunderhaltung und Sicherung
der Leistungsfähigkeit landwirtschaftlicher Nutztiere und Hobbytiere. Dieses Konzept unterscheidet
sich damit von der traditionellen Denkweise, ausschließlich kranke Tiere zu behandeln.

Zugleich erarbeiten wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zur Therapie. Unser Produkt- und Leistungsangebot
entspricht dem Verbraucherwunsch nach rückstandsfreien, risikolosen Lebensmitteln tierischer
Herkunft. Zudem werden Produkte für Pferde und Kleintiere angeboten.

## Forschung im Fokus

Forschung und Entwicklung sind die bedeutendsten Bereiche unseres Unternehmens. Über die
wissenschaftliche Abteilung pflegen wir eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Universitäten und
Forschungseinrichtungen im In- und Ausland. Der intensive Kontakt zur Landwirtschaft und zum
Tierhalter führt zu Produkten, die in der Praxis gebraucht werden.

Veyx-Pharma sichert durch ein verantwortungsbewusstes und konsequentes Controlling die Wirksamkeit,
Qualität und Sicherheit der Produkte. Die Produktion erfolgt nach modernsten Standards in unseren
GMP-zertifizierten Produktionsstätten.

### Qualität als oberstes Gebot

Veyx-Pharma ist QS- und VLOG-Systempartner – Diät-/Ergänzungsfuttermittel sind entsprechend
QS-zertifiziert und VLOG-geprüft.

## Veyx ist eine eingetragene Marke:

Arzneimittel, Futtermittel und Tierpflegemittel – die Produktgruppen sind durch unterschiedliche
Designs und Marken einfach zu unterscheiden.

Die Futtermittel sind unter der Dachmarke **VeyFo® **
und die Tierpflegemittel unter der Marke **SanDitan®** vereinigt.
Die Arzneimittel sind als **Einzelmarken **gekennzeichnet.

### Veyx International

Im Lauf der Jahre hat sich das Unternehmen zu einer international tätigen Firmengruppe entwickelt.
Heute umfasst die Firmengruppe mit Hauptsitz in Schwarzenborn/ Knüll eine eigene
Wirkstoffherstellung, Produktionsbetriebe für unterschiedliche Arzneimittelformen sowie weltweite
Vertriebsstrukturen.

Veyx-Präparate sind von Polen bis Spanien, von Kanada bis China in mehr als 60 Ländern zugelassen.
Veyx-Pharma hat Niederlassungen in Bulgarien, den Niederlanden, Polen und der Slowakei.

Virbac has operated in Australia for over 50 years and has grown organically and through a series of acquisitions. With sales in excess of $100M and a team of over 200 personnel Virbac is one of the top 3 animal health companies in Australia. Virbac takes pride in its ability to develop and manufacture products in Australia, for Australia. The company has 4 sites in NSW with 3 of these dedicated to manufacturing a wide range of dosage forms from tablets and gels to sterile vaccines and implants. Virbac strives to develop and maintain close relationships with its customers. This is delivered by a team of over 60 personnel in sales, marketing and customer service. Virbac RSA is one of the few GMP (Good Manufacture Practice) approved veterinary facilities in South Africa and maintains the high standard required by the M.C.C. (Medicine Control Council) and other statutory bodies. ## **RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT** Research into new veterinary products and their development are at the heart of Virbac's R&D missions. Every day throughout the world, 230 men and women devote all their energy to fulfilling clients' needs and creating the products of tomorrow. In France, where the company has its biggest centre, R&D focuses on two main aspects. Firstly, biological R&D which develops biological products (vaccines, interferon’s, etc.) and, secondly, pharmaceutical R&D which develops all kinds of chemical-based pharmacological therapeutic products (anti-infective, internal and external parasiticides, anti-inflammatories, etc.) intended for all species of animal. Internationally, the skills of the R&D teams are focused on local markets where Virbac is very well represented. In the United States, too, particular attention is being paid to the development of parasiticides and antibiotics for companion animals. In India, the whole range of medicines for food producing animals is a key objective. ## **VIRBAC'S SPECIALITY** Depending on its size, each centre has multi-disciplinary teams and the latest equipment devoted to the studies needed to demonstrate the quality, harmlessness and effectiveness of the company's products. The regulations, which are ever-present in this sphere of activity, impose strict rules of operation concerning good manufacturing, laboratory and clinical practices and drug monitoring. The special feature of R&D at Virbac is the integration of regulatory expertise and thus the assumption of responsibility for all the activities involved in setting up and drafting authorisation dossiers in partnership with the Regulatory Matters team. It is thus naturally in charge of technical and scientific exchanges with the veterinary medicine agencies. The complementary nature of this collaboration between the R&D and Regulatory entities is doubtless what best characterises Virbac's special knowledge in development matters. Zoetis] # Purpose We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business. [Learn More][117] Toggle autoplay [Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis] ### Welcome to Zoetis As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100 countries. We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions. Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and purpose-driven colleagues. xy_audit.axis_definition_reason: These parameters capture the dual nature of animal health: product innovation and manufacturing excellence (X) combined with commercial scale and strategic growth (Y), tailored to the specific needs of veterinary medicine and livestock production.

x.Vaccine & Biologic Portfolio: Breadth and depth of vaccines and biologicals for major species (companion, livestock, poultry). Strength shown by number of licensed products, novel antigen platforms, and market share in core segments.
x.Parasiticide & Anti-Infective Coverage: Range of products for parasites, bacteria, fungi, and viruses across species. Strength indicated by spectrum of activity, convenience of formulations, and resistance management strategies.
x.Diagnostics & Digital Health Integration: Investment in diagnostic tools (e.g., point-of-care tests, imaging) and digital platforms (e.g., telemedicine, data analytics) that enhance disease detection and treatment monitoring. Strength evidenced by product launches, partnerships, and adoption rates.
x.Manufacturing Capacity & Supply Chain: Ability to produce high-quality products at scale with reliable supply. Strength shown by number of facilities, capacity utilization, redundancy, and track record of supply continuity.
x.Regulatory Approvals & Compliance: Portfolio of approvals from major agencies (FDA, EMA, etc.) and compliance with GMP and pharmacovigilance standards. Strength indicated by recent approvals, inspection history, and global registration footprint.

y.Global Market Penetration: Presence and sales across key geographies (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.). Strength shown by revenue distribution, market share in major countries, and entry into emerging markets.
y.Veterinarian & Producer Trust: Reputation among veterinarians and livestock producers based on product efficacy, safety, and support services. Strength evidenced by brand loyalty, prescription rates, and industry surveys.
y.Revenue & Profitability: Financial performance including total revenue, growth rate, and margins. Strength indicated by consistent revenue growth, profitability ratios, and investment in R&D.
y.Pipeline & Label Expansion: Number and stage of products in development, as well as efforts to expand labels for existing products (new species, indications). Strength shown by pipeline size, phase advancement, and recent label extensions.
y.Strategic Alliances & M&A: Partnerships, licensing deals, and acquisitions that enhance product portfolio, technology access, or market reach. Strength indicated by number and value of deals, and their strategic fit.
